name: Index Verifier
description: Read an index back against what is expected to be in it, separating fatal findings from warnings, naming the offending record, and refusing readiness until every check has actually run.
install: No dependencies beyond core-types and vector-store-protocol. Copy with: ragkit add index-verifier
missing_dependency_message: index-verifier needs no package. If it reports NOT READY with no findings, read checks_not_run(): readiness is withheld when a check could not be examined, which is a capability gap rather than a corrupt index.
